verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy: the attribution 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' is set in heavy yellow caps as big as the quote, so the two compete. The quote is squeezed into a narrow 6-line column of two or three words per line, and the product is shrunk into a small circle crammed against the logo on the right. B is essentially a scaled-down copy of the original, which is the 'just shrink it' approach the brief penalises. Its 'SOLSTICE' wordmark and the label on the can are illegibly tiny, the attribution is very small and the can is jammed toward the bottom edge. Still, B keeps the quote as the clear focal point and keeps the original reading order and feel.
